title: error
description: Something went wrong. Inside a call it says what failed; outside a call it says which command the gateway refused.

ErrorEvent.description: Something went wrong. Inside a call it says what failed; outside a call it says which command the gateway refused.

code.description: A stable code a program can match: unknown_command, bad_shape, no_route, tool_timeout, provider_error; and stopped — a member of the org stopped this app (POST /v1/apps/{app}/stop), the socket closes next, and the app exits rather than reconnect.

command.description: The type of the command that failed, when one did.

id.description: The app's id for that command, when it sent one.

recoverable.description: True when the call goes on; false when this is why it ended.
